      "diagnosis": "The preceding paragraph already identifies the default configuration files. This sentence repeats that information while introducing an unclear singular “It.”",
      "quote": "It sets all of the default configuration to run Nushell.",
      "reader_benefit": "Readers can proceed to customization without resolving an ambiguous reference or rereading the description of the defaults.",

    {
      "category": "needless_repetition",
      "diagnosis": "Describing both a series of steps and a series of commands suggests two layers where the sentence defines just one pipeline.",
      "quote": "through a series of steps, in a series of commands",
      "reader_benefit": "Makes the relationship between commands and a pipeline unambiguous.",
      "replacement": "through a series of commands",
      "retained_meaning": "Values pass through a sequence of commands called a pipeline.",
      "unit_ordinal": 40
    },
    {
      "category": "needless_repetition",
      "diagnosis": "The sentence states the absence of mutation twice and delays the concrete pipeline operations with “act as a means to.”",
      "quote": "Rather than using mutation, pipelines act as a means to load, change, and save data without mutable state.",
      "reader_benefit": "Connects the functional-data goal directly to pipeline operations while stating the constraint once.",
      "replacement": "Pipelines load, change, and save data without mutable state.",
      "retained_meaning": "Pipelines perform all three named operations without mutable state.",
